@Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler refused the job because the gateway doesn't have the credentials it needs, so nothing is scheduled and nothing will post on Monday 19 Oct. Someone with gateway admin access needs to fix that first. Once it works, I can create the job for Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, starting 19 Oct, posting here.

When I set it up, I'd build in two limits:
- It reads only #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Both channels have the same members, so nobody would see more than they already can.
- It leaves out money terms and finance documents such as rates, discounts, contract values and invoices. Not everyone in this channel is an account owner or on the deal desk. Tickets, doors, dates, open or closed status and other operational items are fine.

Is there anything else you want in it?
